profile.headline: Software Engineer – Team Lead, Application Development & Architecture at MultiPlan
profile.jobTitle: Software Engineer – Team Lead, Application Development & Architecture

positions.title: Software Engineer – Team Lead, Application Development & Architecture
Programmer / Analyst
positions.description:
At CSC I was the project manager/programmer for a web portal, “AccountStreet.com” (since has been combined with incorporate.com).  I managed all aspects of the technology side of AccountStreet.  
•	Using web services, I utilized a SOAP framework to facilitate our business of on-line incorporation for a Canadian firm.  The Canadian company established a secure connection to our server and used the SOAP framework to send and receive requests during their on-line incorporation process.
•	Analyzed and was responsible for troubleshooting problems on multiple company websites. Created new wizards in ASP utilizing MS-SQL for new products.
•	Researched types of hardware and technology needed to implement migration and upgrade of AccountStreet.
•	Completed a code redesign of AccountStreet.com. Solely responsible for designing, planning, testing, implementing, and data migration.  Converted AccountStreet from VB6 technology to ColdFusion. Moved server platforms from Microsoft (IIS) to Solaris running Apache. Recreated and enhanced the database from MS-SQL Server to Oracle 9i using PL/SQL.
•	Designed and coded two online payment systems; 1) Credit card payment system using SurePay (First Data) payment system utilizing ColdFusion and XML. 2) Direct bank debits payment process using ACH (Automated Clearing House) protocols with PNC bank using SQR. 
These payment processes are solely used for all online payment processing used by CSC. Tens of millions of dollars have been transferred without problems.
•	Created a user interface to enable registered users to use current account information to pay Delaware State corporate tax. Created automated marketing emailing program using Microsoft’s SQL Server Agent to send emails to customers based on extremely complex logistics.

Technologies Utilized:
ColdFusion MX, Oracle (PL/SQL), SQL Server 2000, TSQL, SQL, SQR, VB.Net, VB, SOAP, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, DOM, and Java

positions.title: Customer Support Engineer
positions.description:
•	Project Manager for the conversion and design of an internal application, NOVA, that tracked communications between 2nd tier support, 3rd tier support and software developers.
•	NOVA was written in PowerBuilder 5.0 and converted to VB6 using SQL Server 7.0 enterprise edition.
•	Migrated data from the old system to new system using SQL scripts.
•	Create reports from the SQL Server to determine turnaround times for managers.

Technologies Utilized:
PowerBuilder 5.0, VB6, SQL Server 7.0 Enterprise edition, SQL.

positions.title: Intranet/Internet Designer and Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed an e-commerce website to sell supplies, www.buyxes.com. 
•	Planned, designed and implemented an information sharing server for Xerox employees worldwide. 
•	Transferred information from paper to electronic version. 
•	Designed and created web sites for multiple teams. 
•	Developed a tool using C++ and server-side Java scripting to display daily news for desired length of time. 
•	Managed several Document Management Servers.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
•	Wrote C++ code to test memory on a high-end digital radio.
•	Performed environmental tests and modified the circuit to function within the specified temperature range. 
•	Designed and developed 'breakout' boards. 
•	Tested and debugged circuit boards.
